newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Rayon to consider bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Indian Rayon to consider bonus issue.

text.p: The board of Indian Rayon and Industries Ltd said on Friday its board will meet on May 6 to consider a bonus equity issue.
On Friday, the Aditya Birla group firm raised dividend to 6.75 rupees per 10-rupee face value stock for the year ended March 31, 1997, from 6.25 rupees a year ago.
Net profit in 1996/97 rose to 2.15 billion rupees from 1.85 billion the previous year on higher net sales of 14.12 billion against 12.08 billion.
The firm makes yarn, cement, carbon black and sea water magnesia.
The company made an issue of global depositary receipts for $125 million in January 1994.
